title: Retry native metadata contention without treating it as withdrawn authority
implementation: Read-only native metadata registries distinguish WouldBlock (NotReady) from poisoned state (Authority). Missing sources remain Authority and absent optional routes do not grant permission.

Native readiness authorization maps transient media NotReady to StorageUnavailable for the existing bounded upstream fresh-authority retry; cancellation remains Closed and other failures remain Authority. No old authority is retained across retry.
HTTP/OpenAPI extension and developer lifecycle reference describe the transient boundary. Schema and upstream sources remain unchanged.
